clauses.title: Testing Laboratories — North India
clauses.text:
BIS-recognized testing laboratories in North India:
1. BIS Central Laboratory, New Delhi — Multi-product testing (food, electrical, building materials, chemicals)
2. National Test House (NTH), Ghaziabad, UP — Comprehensive testing for metals, electrical, chemical products
3. ERTL (North), New Delhi — Electronics & IT product testing (CRS scheme)
4. Central Power Research Institute (CPRI), Noida — Electrical equipment testing
5. Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP), Dehradun — Petroleum product testing
6. NABL-accredited private labs: SGS India (Gurgaon), TUV SUD (Noida), Bureau Veritas (Delhi NCR)
7. STQC Lab, New Delhi — IT/electronics product testing for CRS
8. BIS Branch Office Lab, Chandigarh — Covers Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh

clauses.title: Testing Laboratories — West India
clauses.text:
BIS-recognized testing laboratories in West India:
1. BIS Western Regional Office Lab, Mumbai — Multi-product testing facility
2. SGS India Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai — Food, chemicals, consumer products
3. ERTL (West), Mumbai — Electronics and IT goods testing for CRS
4. NABL Labs in Mumbai: Intertek, TUV Rheinland
5. BIS Branch Office Lab, Ahmedabad — Covers Gujarat region
6. NABL-accredited labs in Ahmedabad: Shriram Institute, GERI (Gujarat Engineering Research Institute)
7. BIS Branch Office, Pune — Testing support for Maharashtra
8. BIS Regional Office, Jaipur — Covers Rajasthan
9. National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) accredited labs in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Goa

clauses.title: Testing Laboratories — South India
clauses.text:
BIS-recognized testing laboratories in South India:
1. ETDC (Electronic Test and Development Centre), Bengaluru — Electronics product testing
2. ERTL (South), Bengaluru — CRS scheme electronics testing
3. CPRI (Central Power Research Institute), Bengaluru — Electrical equipment, transformers, cables
4. BIS Branch Office Lab, Chennai — Multi-product testing for Tamil Nadu
5. NABL Labs in Chennai: SITRA (South India Textile Research Association), IITM Testing Centre
6. BIS Branch Office Lab, Hyderabad — Covers Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
7. CFTRI (Central Food Technological Research Institute), Mysuru — Food product testing
8. BIS Branch Office, Kochi — Covers Kerala
9. CSIR-CLRI (Central Leather Research Institute), Chennai — Leather and footwear testing
10. Quality Council of India (QCI) recognized labs across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, AP, and Telangana

clauses.title: Testing Laboratories — East India
clauses.text:
BIS-recognized testing laboratories in East India:
1. ERTL (East), Kolkata — Electronics and IT product testing for CRS
2. National Test House (NTH), Kolkata — One of India's oldest and largest testing facilities (metals, chemicals, building materials, food, textiles)
3. BIS Eastern Regional Office Lab, Kolkata — Multi-product testing
4. CGCRI (Central Glass and Ceramic Research Institute), Kolkata — Glass, ceramics testing
5. BIS Branch Office, Patna — Covers Bihar and Jharkhand
6. BIS Branch Office, Bhubaneswar — Covers Odisha
7. NEIST (North East Institute of Science and Technology), Jorhat, Assam — Testing for North East India
8. IIT Kharagpur testing facilities — Available for specific product categories
9. NTH Guwahati — Covers the entire North East region

clauses.title: Testing Laboratories — Central India
clauses.text:
BIS-recognized testing laboratories in Central India:
1. BIS Branch Office Lab, Bhopal — Covers Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh
2. BIS Branch Office Lab, Nagpur — Sub-region of Maharashtra (Vidarbha)
3. AMPRI (Advanced Materials and Processes Research Institute), Bhopal — Materials testing
4. NABL-accredited private labs in Indore and Raipur
5. Regional Testing Centre, Lucknow — Covers Eastern UP

The complete, updated directory of BIS-recognized laboratories is available at:
www.bis.gov.in → 'Resources' → 'Recognised Laboratories'
Labs are categorized by product type: electrical, food, construction materials, chemicals, textiles, etc.
NABL accreditation is a prerequisite for BIS lab recognition.
